title: Discovery and architecture decision gates
user_visible_behavior: The team has explicit technical boundaries and OI gates before committing to production architecture.
verification_command: Each of 20 flows and 45 scenarios has an owner/slice; every OI is traceable as open, answered or deferred.

title: Thin shared foundation and access
user_visible_behavior: Each role reaches only its authorized Dolores records; Admin manages accounts/shops/status/access and Moderator creates Tenant accounts only.
verification_command: Server denies cross-Tenant IDs and unauthorized Moderator/Admin actions; authorized role flows load exact records after refresh.
notes: Covers MF-20/S01 and access prerequisites for all flows.

title: Rental contract, machine record and handover
user_visible_behavior: Tenant and Moderator complete a signed rental record and view the delivered conventional or Smart machine with correct location and history.
verification_command: MF-01–MF-03 and MF-15/MF-17 passed; duplicate primary machine allocation and wrong Tenant/shop links are rejected.

title: Smart IoT, PAYG, telemetry and menus
user_visible_behavior: Tenant and internal staff see exact Smart telemetry, confirmed menu state and private recipes; conventional units do not expose Smart features.
verification_command: Valid cup events count once by exact machine and active assignment; device-confirmed menu/GPS is distinct from contract location; OI-gated behavior remains blocked.
notes: Covers MF-06, MF-07, MF-17/S02 and Smart portion of MF-03.

title: Billing, payment evidence and reconciliation
user_visible_behavior: Tenant submits payment proof and confirmation; Moderator separately reconciles bank receipt; Admin reports only reconciled receipts with deposits separated.
verification_command: MF-04–MF-05 happy paths preserve upload and reconcile timestamps; late ordinary cups carry forward; OI-05/06/07/09/10/17 gates are not guessed.
notes: Covers MF-04, MF-05, billing handoff from MF-06 and MF-20/S02 data.

title: Support, maintenance, repair and replacement
user_visible_behavior: Tenant follows a support request through Moderator dispatch and Technician completion; approved service SLA deadlines and actual milestones are visible without a Technician scheduling calendar; service history and same-type replacement use are linked to the correct contract.
verification_command: MF-08–MF-09 and MF-16 pass; SLA status uses approved service terms and clock rules only; wrong technician, overlapping or cross-type replacement updates are denied.
notes: Covers MF-08, MF-09, MF-16, history parts of MF-15; OI-19 gates SLA targets, clock calculations and alerts.

title: Expiry, termination, deposit settlement and new contract
user_visible_behavior: Tenant and Moderator close a rental after Technician recovery/assessment; continuation creates a separate contract and eligible external refunds are tracked.
verification_command: MF-10–MF-14 pass for approved cases; settlement cannot precede the exact Technician assessment; unresolved date/refund cases are blocked.

title: Used-machine buyback and stock release
user_visible_behavior: Eligible Tenant and Moderator track buyback evidence separately from acknowledgement, then Technician collection/refurbishment/testing precedes Moderator stock release.
verification_command: MF-18–MF-19 pass; collection/payment alone or a failed/missing test cannot mark a machine available.
notes: Covers MF-18–MF-19 and inventory/history portion of MF-15.

title: Reporting, reminders, responsive UX and hardening
user_visible_behavior: All four roles use record-backed dashboards/reminders, approved SLA compliance views and complete key flows on mobile with exact deep links and readable confirmation/error states.
verification_command: All 20 flows/45 scenarios have pass evidence or named OI-blocked status; SLA metrics exclude unconfigured targets; routes retain exact IDs; responsive/security/integrity checks meet approved targets.
notes: Covers MF-20/S02 plus cross-flow reminders, reporting, mobile, SLA overview and final verification; OI-19 gates SLA metrics/alerts.
